stage1.impression: A clean, symmetrical render of a timber box with two red acrylic speakers on terrazzo plinths and a rainbow-rimmed acrylic globe between them. It reads as a showroom or a game interior, not a night room: everything is evenly lit mid-brown, the slat walls look like a printed texture, the floor reads as camouflage blotches, and the globe's six saturated rims compete with the speakers for colour. A magazine would see a generic CG listening room, not a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: Frame is a night room: lum_median 22 to 50 (now 64.7), with real pools of light and dark between them rather than an even brown wash
End-grain oak floor reads as end-grain blocks at their real scale (about 50 to 100 mm, growth rings, joints), not as large irregular camouflage cells
Oak slat walls and lid read as real slats with relief, shadowed gaps and varied boards, not as a flat repeated wallpaper texture
The Tropos pair reads as the hero: speaker regions lum_median 45 or more, glowing polished acrylic edges, no clipped highlights on the horns
Terrazzo chips at a believable honed-terrazzo scale and contrast, not oversized salt-and-pepper speckle
Signs of life in the room: a glass, a record out of its sleeve, the lounge chairs and rug read in frame
No visible volumetric shaft from the ceiling and no blown caustic pool on the floor

defects.what: Whole frame too bright and flat for a night room: lum_median 64.7, only 22.8 % below 40; no pools of dark
End-grain floor reads as camouflage / Voronoi blotches about 30 to 60 px across, no grain, no block joints, wrong scale; median 70.5, brighter than the walls
Oak slat walls and ceiling read as a flat striped texture with no relief or shadowed gaps; regular repeat
Terrazzo plinths: chips too large and too high contrast, reads as granite speckle or a printed texture
Mother EARF's rims in six saturated hues (blue, green, pink, yellow) compete with the Ember pair; the frame no longer has one colour
Visible haze shaft from the ceiling above the globe, reads as a stage light / CG volumetric
Caustic pool on the floor under the globe is the brightest broad area (median 132), a hot spot that pulls the eye off the speakers
Left speaker median 38.1 (below 45), its acrylic reads as uniformly lit pink-red sheet; clip 0.86 % on the horn and panel edges
Right speaker median 40.0, clip 1.2 % at the horn rim
Cut-off oak panels at the left edge read as unexplained flat boards, no context
Lounge chairs and rug cut to slivers at the right edge; no props or sign of life anywhere
Back counter and black boxes read as untextured blocks

changes.problem: The room is lit evenly like a showroom, not as a night room with pools of light.

evidence.measured: lum_median 64.7, below_40 22.8 %; walls 780-1200 x 0-380 median 66.7; ceiling band median 46.6

change.setting: render exposure; inside the lantern fill and the trap

changes.expected: Frame median drops to about 40, walls and ceiling fall into warm shadow, the pools on speakers and globe carry the frame.

changes.problem: The speakers are darker than the walls around them, so they do not read as the hero.

evidence.measured: left speaker median 38.1, right 40.0, while the wall behind is 66.7

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots
change.to: 2 x 55 W, 26 deg, 2600 K, aimed at the cabinet face so light passes through the acrylic and catches its edges

changes.expected: Speakers become the brightest coloured objects against a darker room, polished edges glow.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's spot throws a hot caustic pool on the floor and a visible haze shaft from the ceiling.

evidence.measured: floor pool median 132.3, p95 200.7; shaft region 400-470 x 30-270 median 74.5

change.from: 1 x spot 140.0 W, 18.0 deg, 3000 K; haze 0.002 per meter
change.to: 1 x spot 70 W, 24 deg, 2700 K; haze 0.0008 per meter

changes.expected: The coloured shadow stays as a soft tinted pool, no longer the brightest broad area; the ceiling shaft disappears.

changes.problem: The end-grain oak floor reads as camouflage blotches at the wrong scale.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: irregular cells 30-60 px, no rings or joints; median 70.5, brighter than the walls

change.setting: end-grain oak finish (tone and texture within its kind)
change.to: square end-grain blocks about 60 mm with dark joints, visible growth rings, oiled satin roughness 0.4, tone darkened about 30 %

changes.expected: Floor reads as end-grain blocks and sits darker than the speakers.

changes.problem: Oak slat walls and lid read as a flat printed stripe.

evidence.measured: lum_range 97.7 but no shadow at the slot gaps when cropped; regular repeat

change.to: modelled or displaced slats with 8-10 mm dark gaps, per-board tone variation of plus or minus 10 %, oak tone one step darker

changes.expected: Walls show relief and shadowed gaps and fall darker, the room feels closer.

changes.problem: Terrazzo chips are oversized and high contrast, reading as granite or a printed speckle.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: chips 10-20 px on a 245 px plinth, near-white on near-black

change.setting: terrazzo chip size and ground tone
change.to: chips about half the size, warmer mid-grey ground, lower chip contrast, honed roughness 0.35

changes.expected: Plinths read as honed terrazzo and recede below the speakers.

changes.problem: The room has no sign of life, and the lounge chairs and rug are cut to slivers.

evidence.measured: seen: only chair legs at the right edge; no glasses or records anywhere

change.to: a lowball glass and a record out of its sleeve on a side table or the plinth edge in the foreground, a sleeve leaning against the right plinth

changes.expected: The room reads as used, a magazine sign of life.

changes.problem: The frame is a flat symmetrical showroom view with unexplained cut panels at the left edge.

evidence.measured: seen: a flat oak board fills the left 160 px with no context

change.to: about 0.4 m to the right and lower to seated eye level 1.05 m, 35 mm, so a lounge chair arm and rug edge frame the bottom-right foreground and the left board leaves frame

changes.expected: A seated listener's view, with depth from the foreground chair; no pixel test because the camera moves every region.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce or unify the colour of Mother EARF's six tinted rims so the Ember pair is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF is an EARF product as placed, fixed by the card; only her spot can change

out_of_scope.request: Hide or thicken the thin supports holding the horns above the cabinets
out_of_scope.why: Change to the speaker itself, never prescribed

out_of_scope.request: Thicker acrylic panels with deeper polished edges on the Tropos
Replace the oak box walls with concrete or plaster for material contrast
out_of_scope.why: The lantern's oak interior is fixed architecture
